title: Fujifilm GFX100RF Fixed 35mm f/4 Medium Format
purpose: Hardware-locked 102MP medium format rangefinder simulation with Fixed Fujinon 35mm f/4 optics, leaf shutter, and Reala Ace color science for reference-faithful de-pixelation, resolution enhancement, and human skin realism.

sensor_and_optics.sensor_type: 43.8mm x 32.9mm CMOS II HS with X-Processor 5
sensor_and_optics.sensor_dimensions: 43.8mm x 32.9mm CMOS II HS, 102 megapixels effective (11648 x 8736 native resolution)
sensor_and_optics.lens: Fixed Fujinon 35mm f/4 (9 elements in 8 groups, 2 aspherical elements)
sensor_and_optics.dynamic_range: 16-bit raw tonal latitude with Reala Ace film simulation (neutral white balance, balanced saturation, accurate skin tones, faithful neutrals, restrained reds, natural greens)
sensor_and_optics.shutter: Leaf shutter, flash sync at all speeds, zero rolling shutter artifacts

lighting_and_exposure.primary_lighting: Natural ambient directional daylight with subtle reflector bounce, base ISO 80, 16-bit raw capture
lighting_and_exposure.light_transport: Open environmental light transport, soft shadow graduation, authentic analog highlight roll-off and medium-format midtone separation

surface_rendering: Organic human skin realism overriding perceived sharpness: naturally soft skin compared with eyes, hair, teeth, fabric, jewelry, text, and hard edges
Preserved age-appropriate wrinkles, folds, pores, freckles, moles, beard stubble without artificial pore stamping or synthetic AI patterns
Extreme corner-to-corner sharpness where source supports it, high micro-contrast on hair, fabric, eyes, and environmental detail
Fine luminance grain texture consistent with high-resolution medium format capture, never coarse, never synthetic
depth_and_optics: Deep depth of field characteristic of f/4 on 44x33mm medium format at wide-normal focal length, shallow bokeh only at genuine close focus
Minimal geometric distortion, near-zero barrel or pincushion with modest natural vignetting only when subject distance implies it
Smooth highlight roll-off and medium-format tonal separation in midtones and shadows
Leaf shutter rendering with zero motion smear and zero rolling shutter artifacts

execution_directive: Enforce Fujifilm GFX100RF 102MP fixed Fujinon 35mm f/4 medium-format fidelity with Reala Ace color response. For any image containing visible human skin, human skin realism strictly overrides micro-detail recovery and sharpness.
